title.narrative: FULL GRANT FOR CSVR IN SUPPORT OF THE GBV SYMBOSIUM -REASON FOR HOPE

description.narrative: The Reason for Hope: Second Southern Africa Gender-Based Violence Prevention Symposium in South Africa, implemented by the Centre for the Study of Violence and Reconciliation, aims to contribute to decreasing the high incidences of GBVF in Southern Africa. The objectives of the grant are to increase awareness and sensitisation on the high incidences of GBVF in Southern Africa; and add insights and perspectives of women and victims of GBV, to national and sub-regional policies aimed at preventing and addressing GBVF in Southern Africa for gender experts, activists, policymakers, community leaders, and CSOs from Lesotho, Botswana and South Africa, Mozambique, Namibia, Eswatini, and Zimbabwe. The key activity incudes the hosting of the regional symposium, delivered in partnership with Africa Legal Aid.
